That confirms the match in `format.js` is the function definition, not a call site — excluding it, there are **17 actual call sites** passing the second argument, across 7 files.

**Breakdown:**
| File | Two-arg calls |
|---|---|
| `src/reports/quarterly.js` | 5 |
| `src/billing/invoice.js` | 3 |
| `src/admin/exports.js` | 3 |
| `src/reports/monthly.js` | 2 |
| `src/checkout/cart.js` | 2 |
| `src/checkout/receipt.js` | 1 |
| `src/billing/statement.js` | 1 |

**`src/reports/quarterly.js` has the most**, with 5 call sites passing `true` (lines 16, 37, 58, 83, 104) for `row.bundle`, `row.holdback`, `row.subtotal`, `row.surcharge`, and `row.gross`.
